description: This file defines the SimpleEventHandler class which implements the EventHandler interface. It processes web events in the OFBiz framework by executing associated Mini-Lang scripts, managing transactions, and handling errors.

classes.name: SimpleEventHandler
classes.description: Handles web events by executing mini-language scripts, managing transactions, and error handling within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the event handler with the servlet context (no implementation in this class).

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Processes an event by executing its associated Mini-Lang script, manages transactions, and handles exceptions, returning the event result or 'error'.
